tickets.text: I cannot open our company's internal application website. It was working earlier, but now the page does not load. Other websites seem to work normally.
Users in the office network cannot access http://app.enterprise.test/. However, accessing the application directly through 10.30.10.10 returns HTTP 200.
The company application is not working. Can someone check what is wrong?
I think the application server may have crashed or a recent deployment broke the website. The application URL keeps failing.
